S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S069.name: Intrusive_Symptoms
S069.description: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.

subtypes.Intrusive Memories: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Distressing Dreams: Recurrent distressing dreams in which the content and/or affect of the dream are related to the traumatic event.
subtypes.Dissociative Reactions (Flashbacks): Dissociative reactions (e.g., flashbacks) in which the individual feels or acts as if the traumatic event were recurring.
subtypes.Psychological Distress at Cues: Intense or prolonged psychological distress at exposure to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Physiological Reactions to Cues: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.

S071.name: Trauma_Related_Amnesia
S071.description: Inability to remember an important aspect of the traumatic event (typically due to dissociative amnesia and not to other factors like head injury or alcohol).

subtypes.Fragmented Memory: Inability to recall only specific parts of the traumatic event while remembering others.
subtypes.Generalized Amnesia: Inability to recall the majority or the entirety of the traumatic event.

S076.name: Inability_Positive_Emotions
S076.description: Persistent inability to experience positive emotions (e.g., inability to experience happiness, satisfaction, or loving feelings).

subtypes.Anhedonia for Happiness: Unable to feel happiness or joy even when good things happen.
subtypes.Lack of Satisfaction: Unable to experience satisfaction or pride even after achieving something good.
subtypes.Inability to Feel Love: Feeling numb to love or affection towards family or lovers.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where the mind feels empty and nothing is felt, as if all positive emotions are blocked.

S077.name: Irritability_Aggression
S077.description: Irritable behavior and angry outbursts (with little or no provocation) typically expressed as verbal or physical aggression.

subtypes.Impulsive Anger: Sudden explosions of anger for trivial reasons or no clear reason.
subtypes.Verbal Aggression: Attacking others with shouting, cursing, or blame without holding back.
subtypes.Physical Aggression: Physically attacking people or throwing/breaking objects.
subtypes.Chronic Irritability: A state where nerves are always sharp and sensitive, ready to explode at the slightest touch.

S079.name: Hypervigilance
S079.description: Persistent state of being alert and tense about the surrounding environment.

subtypes.Scanning for Danger: Always scanning the surroundings and being alert to find potential threats or risks.
subtypes.Safety Checking: Repetitively confirming safety, such as checking exit locations or observing people around.
subtypes.Sustained Alertness: Unable to relax tension even in safe environments and maintaining a constant state of alertness.

info.persona: Amanda Gibson, a 36‑year‑old logistics enthusiast, blends methodical organization with a perpetual worry, channeling curiosity into garden experiments and true‑crime sleuthing, while they occasionally succumb to late‑night snack binges after a stressful shift.
info.professional_persona: Amanda Gibson is an experienced retail and warehouse operations specialist who leverages a decade of inventory control, barcode scanning, and POS expertise, applying their methodical, organized nature and practical curiosity to streamline stock processes, while their assertive yet cooperative style earns the team’s respect as they pursue a supervisory role.
info.cultural_background: Amanda was born and raised in Flintville, a small town in Franklin County, Tennessee. Her family roots trace back several generations to English and Scotch-Irish settlers who established farms in the Appalachian foothills. She grew up in a close-knit, predominantly white community where church attendance, family reunions, and neighborhood barbecues were central to social life. The Southern values of hospitality, self-reliance, and hard work were reinforced by her parents, who emphasized the importance of punctuality and responsibility. While she respects local traditions, Amanda also embraces a broader curiosity, often attending community workshops on gardening and genealogy, reflecting a blend of classic Southern upbringing and a desire to explore new ideas.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Amanda finds balance between her demanding work schedule and her need for personal downtime through a blend of quiet and social activities. She enjoys tending to her modest vegetable garden, where she applies her practical curiosity to experiment with heirloom tomatoes and seasonal herbs. In the evenings, she often curls up with mystery and true-crime novels, appreciating the mental challenge they provide. Crafting is another outlet; she knits scarves and quilts for family and friends, a hobby that offers both creativity and a sense of accomplishment. On weekends, she hikes the nearby Natchez Trace trail, listens to classic country radio, and occasionally volunteers at the local food pantry, where her organized nature helps streamline donation sorting.
info.sports_persona: Amanda Gibson is a dedicated member of the Natchez Trace Hiking Club, enjoys weekend treks along the trail, roots for the Tennessee Titans and Nashville Predators, and fits in modest cardio sessions by walking the trail after work, though they rarely engage in organized team sports beyond occasional community softball games.
info.arts_persona: Amanda Gibson finds creative solace in knitting and quilting while listening to classic country legends such as Dolly Parton and George Strait, they celebrate mystery literature by devouring novels by Agatha Christie and Gillian Flynn, and occasionally attend local theater productions of classics like ‘A Streetcar Named Desire.’
info.travel_persona: Amanda Gibson prefers meticulously planned weekend getaways that blend nature and heritage, often traveling to nearby Asheville, the Great Smoky Mountains, and Charleston for hiking and historic tours, while they dream of a longer road‑trip through Savannah and New Orleans once their schedule stabilizes and finances allow.
info.culinary_persona: Amanda Gibson enjoys cooking with their garden’s heirloom tomatoes, fresh basil, and sweet corn, often preparing Southern staples like chicken and dumplings or smoked collard greens seasoned with a dash of hot sauce, yet they sometimes over‑salt their bruschetta while experimenting with new herb blends in their modest kitchen.

info.persona: Edwin Medina balances the rhythm of a factory floor with the heartbeat of a family feast, often seen toggling a spreadsheet on one screen and a paella pan on the stove, all while humming flamenco tunes and secretly hoarding a stash of vintage salsa bottles for midnight dance sessions.
info.professional_persona: Edwin Medina, a 40‑year‑old operations manager at a high‑tempo manufacturing facility, merges deep expertise in process optimization, supply‑chain coordination, budgeting, and safety compliance with a pragmatic yet curious mindset, driving team performance the way a well‑practiced soccer formation balances structure and improvisation.
info.cultural_background: Edwin grew up in a Spanish‑heritage household, where family meals, flamenco music, and celebrations such as Semana Santa cultivated a strong sense of community and appreciation for tradition. Bilingual from childhood, he carries the warmth and collectivist values of Spanish culture into his daily interactions, while his adult life in Riverside, California, blends in a West Coast love for outdoor activities, multicultural experiences, and a pragmatic approach to work. This dual cultural lens informs his collaborative style, his love for Spanish cuisine, and his openness to new ideas balanced against proven methods.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Edwin stays active and socially engaged. He plays on a local weekend soccer league, hikes the trails of the San Bernardino foothills, and enjoys cooking traditional Spanish dishes like paella and tapas for friends. He regularly attends community music and cultural festivals, practices landscape photography, and volunteers at a Riverside food‑bank, where his kindness and teamwork shine. He also follows tech news and historical non‑fiction, feeding his balanced curiosity.
info.sports_persona: Edwin Medina sparks energy on the Riverside Soccer Club’s weekend league, hikes the San Bernardino foothills every other Saturday, and cheers for the LA Galaxy and LA Dodgers, embodying an active lifestyle that mixes team sport camaraderie with solo adventure.
info.arts_persona: Edwin Medina immerses in cultural festivals featuring flamenco guitarists like Paco de Lucía, captures sunrise over the Mojave inspired by Ansel Adams, and enjoys evenings at the local theater watching productions of Carmen, weaving artistic appreciation into his social calendar.
info.travel_persona: Edwin Medina prefers road‑trip itineraries that blend hiking in Joshua Tree, photography sessions at the Grand Canyon, and evenings at boutique Spanish tapas bars in San Diego, while dreaming of a future cultural pilgrimage to Barcelona’s La Sagrada Família and Lisbon’s historic Alfama district.
info.culinary_persona: Edwin Medina whips up paella Valenciana with saffron, chorizo, and fresh seafood for friends, masters patatas bravas and tortilla española as a moderately skilled home chef, and savors occasional meals at the downtown Mercado, reflecting a deep love for vibrant Mediterranean flavors.

info.persona: Hetalben Adnan fuses disciplined leadership with a curiosity‑driven love for sustainable ingenuity, all while habitually watering their garden at 5 am and occasionally forgetting to turn off the kitchen lights during late‑night culinary experiments.
info.professional_persona: Hetalben Adnan, a senior executive leading a technology firm, leverages a strong STEM foundation, strategic vision, and rigorous operational discipline to drive sustainable AI‑driven product development, while they maintain high standards through organized processes and compassionate yet assertive team leadership.
info.cultural_background: Hetalben is a second‑generation South Asian American of Indian heritage, raised in Michigan. Her family preserves cultural practices such as celebrating Diwali, Navratri, and other festivals, cooking traditional cuisine, and speaking Gujarati at home. The South Asian emphasis on education, disciplined work ethic, and respect for community ties has shaped her professional drive and personal values. While she has embraced American individualism, she continues to honor collectivist principles through community involvement with local cultural associations and mentorship of youth from similar backgrounds. As an unmarried woman who achieved a chief‑executive role, she balances traditional expectations with modern self‑determination, weaving her cultural identity into both her leadership style and personal pursuits.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In her leisure time, Hetalben enjoys reading non‑fiction works on science, technology, and leadership, and listening to both classical Indian music and Western classical piano pieces. She practices yoga and mindfulness meditation to maintain emotional resilience. Gardening is a therapeutic hobby, where she cultivates native Michigan plants alongside heirloom vegetables. She spends quiet evenings woodworking small projects and experimenting with traditional South Asian cooking, often creating fusion recipes. Volunteering for local STEM outreach programs that inspire young girls, attending intimate art exhibitions, and participating in small cultural gatherings also enrich her personal life.
info.sports_persona: Hetalben Adnan follows the Detroit Tigers and Detroit Red Wings, and they commit to a weekly low‑impact fitness routine that includes a senior walking group and bi‑weekly yoga sessions, balancing competitive spirit with mindful movement.
info.arts_persona: Hetalben Adnan curates their artistic palate with visits to intimate galleries featuring Michigan painter Susan Kelleher, while their playlists blend Ravi Shankar’s sitar improvisations with Chopin nocturnes, and they occasionally rehearse a Beethoven sonata on their upright piano.
info.travel_persona: Hetalben Adnan prefers meticulously planned journeys that blend cultural immersion and nature, such as a solo hike through Michigan’s Porcupine Mountains, a week‑long stay at a Kyoto machiya to study tea ceremony, and a restorative weekend at Sedona’s red‑rock retreats, always booking off‑season to align with their budget and health schedule.
info.culinary_persona: Hetalben Adnan demonstrates a confident, experimental cooking style, mastering traditional dal and roti foundations while creating fusion dishes like cardamom‑infused paneer tacos and beet‑and‑blueberry quinoa salad, and they delight in sourcing heirloom Michigan tomatoes and fresh rosemary from their garden.
